✦ Iris Hawthorne’s Engraving Bench

Spotting a Story Crossroads on the Shelf

“Before any Story Crossroads edition leaves our porch, I stamp its lower-right corner with one of two circular medallions in Deep Compass Teal and Warm Brass—so you know right away whether a 2-Way or 3-Way horizon awaits inside.” — Iris Hawthorne

Sister Crest to Ocean View Archives

Iris designed the four-point star above the signpost cap and the diagonal compass rays inside the inner ring as a tribute to Isabel’s Ocean View Archives crest—uniting both sibling libraries at a glance.

Clear Contrast Over Every Cover

Whether Rowan’s map leads into sunlit emerald timber or beneath a starlit midnight sky, a soft shadow halo behind Iris’s medallion keeps the signpost crisp and legible on every screen size.

RaggieSoft Story Crossroads

An unincorporated creative publishing imprint by Michael P. Ragsdale dedicated to standalone interactive novels where every choice opens a full-hearted literary route.
